_about: Origin of every file in tests/fixtures. tools/release_check.py fails on a fixture that is not listed here. origin: synthetic = generated with invented companies, text and figures (generator named in 'how'); hand-made = written by hand, invented content; transformed = the layout of a real document kept (headings, section numbers, page numbers, line wrapping), every other word replaced by filler, names and contacts removed, every figure's digits permuted (report years, months, days and small counts kept); no original sentence, name or figure survives; own-output = aggregates or model answers from the project's own Jev runs, no issuer text. No third-party page, PDF, filing or API dump may be added here.
